## Sample R Code

Here's a simple R code demonstration:

Create a sample dataset
x <- 1:10
y <- x^2

Calculate mean
mean_x <- mean(x)
mean_y <- mean(y)

Print results
cat("Mean of x:", mean_x, "\n")
cat("Mean of y:", mean_y, "\n")

Create a simple plot
plot(x, y, type="b", col="blue",
main="Simple Plot Example",
xlab="X values", ylab="Y values")
